pages.title: The camp's rite
text: The Healing Circle is a [world rite](world_rites). Build a [Rite Circle](rite_circle), seat a **Spirit Seal** in the brazier, and cast the tablet: **500 Pulse**, and the circle stays open **10 minutes** (a tier-two circle, with four Spirit totems, is cheaper and lasts longer).
When it opens, everyone within **12 blocks**, players and bonded familiars, is healed **10 hearts**, loses every harmful effect and gains **10 minutes** of [Spirit Blessing](spirit_sickness).

pages.title: While it stays open
text: For the rest of its time, the circle mends everyone inside **a heart every two seconds** and lifts Spirit Sickness as soon as it takes hold. It is a good place to fall back to.

pages.title: Calling the fallen back
text: When a **bonded familiar** dies, it no longer just vanishes. It leaves a glowing **Spirit Remnant** where it fell, which never despawns, and you get a message telling you so. (Not to be confused with the wild remnants of the March: this is your companion's spirit, waiting.)

Lay the remnant on one of the circle's **four pedestals** before you cast. When the circle opens, the familiar comes back on that pedestal: **whole**, still yours, with its name and its lattice. What it was carrying dropped where it fell, as always, so pick that up too.
